contracts.semantic_contract: Recognize text containing a capacity statement and at least one of the objective terms revenue, profit, or value. Extract each matching container or package record's first numeric field as resource and second as value. Select a binary subset maximizing total value subject to total resource not exceeding the single extracted capacity. Dollar amounts in comma-grouped thousands are normalized by the trusted currency_thousands rule; plain values and K-suffixed values remain unchanged. This is a declarative model specification, not a solution or a claim of broader semantic coverage.

invariants: Each matching item record contributes one binary decision variable.
The selected records' resource sum must not exceed the extracted capacity.
The objective maximizes the sum of selected value coefficients.
Reordering records does not change the feasible selections or objective values.

metamorphic_tests.expectation: Extracted coefficients and capacity remain the same, and the modeled optimization problem is unchanged.
metamorphic_tests.transform: Reorder the item records while leaving scalar text unchanged.

metamorphic_tests.expectation: The set of optimal binary selections is unchanged; objective values scale by that factor.
metamorphic_tests.transform: Multiply every extracted item value by the same positive factor while leaving resources and capacity unchanged.
